title: FIELD_VALUES decoding requires resource.DecodeSearchValues plus exact field-name constants
answers: How to parse a FIELD_VALUES ResourceSearchResponse into a typed hit struct
Why is a requested field coming back empty/zero in FIELD_VALUES search results
What fields must match between the search request and the result parser
body:
Root cause: with ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES, values are returned per-row as a generic map keyed by field name (via resource.DecodeSearchValues(result.Fields, row)), not as fixed table columns; each hit field must be pulled from this map by the same field-name constant used in the request's Fields list (e.g. builders.USER_EMAIL, builders.USER_LOGIN, resource.SEARCH_FIELD_CREATED, legacyIDField), with a type assertion that silently zero-values on mismatch.
Fix pattern: keep the Fields slice passed in the ResourceSearchRequest and the keys used when reading from the decoded values map derived from the same shared constants (builders package / resource.SEARCH_FIELD_*), so a typo or renamed constant doesn't silently drop a field.
Constraints: applies to any handler that sets ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES; type assertions like `values[x].(string)` fail silently (ok=false) rather than erroring, so adding a new field also needs a test asserting the value round-trips.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/search.go parseFieldValueResults and similar FIELD_VALUES consumers
says: Search results return empty values for fields that were explicitly requested
How do I correctly extract requested fields from search response data
Requested search fields show up empty or with no value in results
Field name mismatches between search request and result parser cause data loss
search: When using ResultFormat FIELD_VALUES in search results, values are returned as a generic per-row map keyed by field name, not as fixed table columns; each value must be decoded using resource.DecodeSearchValues and retrieved by the exact field-name constant used in the request's Fields list (e.g., builders.USER_EMAIL, builders.USER_LOGIN, resource.SEARCH_FIELD_CREATED, legacyIDField). Type assertions like `values[x].(string)` fail silently (ok=false) on key mismatch rather than erroring, so typos or renamed constants silently drop fields without error. Fix pattern: keep Fields slice and decoding keys derived from shared constants in builders package and resource.SEARCH_FIELD_*, and add tests asserting round-trip values. Applies to FIELD_VALUES search handlers like pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/search.go:parseFieldValueResults.
